keySentence: Dorothy wanted to go home because she missed her family.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Dorothy made new friends in Oz. But she still thought about her family every night. She missed Auntie Em and Uncle Henry. Dorothy wanted to go home because she missed her family.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Dorothy had seen so many wonders in the Land of Oz. She had made friends with a Scarecrow, a Tin Man, and a Lion. They were kind and brave, and she loved them dearly. But every night, Dorothy thought of Auntie Em and Uncle Henry. Dorothy wanted to go home because she missed her family so much.
facts.Word cards: wanted = 원했다 / missed = 그리워했다 / home = 집 / family = 가족
